values.prompt:
Create one polished 16:9 Location Sheet for the Constantinople sea walls: a single finished spatial reference board for siege shot planning, not a poster or mood board.

## Authoritative geography
The city lies behind the continuous wall line; the Ottoman field lies in front. The principal gate, adjacent tower pair, ditch, approach road, and one damaged masonry section remain in fixed positions in every view.

## Views
Make the largest panel an establishing view from the Ottoman field toward the wall. Add its matched reverse from the city side looking toward the field, one view along the wall from the left, one along the wall from the right, and one clean top-down map showing the same wall, city edge, field, gate, towers, ditch, road, and damaged section.

## Continuity and appearance
Keep architecture, landmark order, distances, state, materials, smoke, and golden-hour lighting consistent across all four views and the map. Keep labels small and outside important visual content.

## Exclusions
No material swatches, prop studies, lighting-study panels, human-scale panel, palette cards, extra filler, modern roads, electrical wires, signage, vehicles, glass curtain walls, industrial streetlights, debug overlays, crop marks, UI, or decorative poster typography.
